subject: Re: Kickoff: Felix assisted-rewrite track
body:
Priya — resourcing for Felix.

Staffing: Tereza 60%, Fumiko 40%, Maren 50% through the window. Compute: fine-tuning the tagging and insertion models is BERT-scale, so 16 A100s best-effort on titan covers the DiscoFuse repro and the internal-corpus runs.

The bigger item is human evaluation. Rewrite quality doesn't reduce to exact-match metrics, and we have no tool for side-by-side sentence ratings, so we're scoping and staffing a human-rating annotation UI from scratch — Maren leads the build at roughly 50% for four weeks: paired original/rewrite presentation, 5-point fluency and meaning-preservation scales, rater-agreement tracking. Target: tool ready by end of March so April ratings aren't blocked. Rater budget: about $6k through the vendor pool.

One dependency: the internal rewrite corpus comes via Corpus, and I want extraction done well before their migration crunch.

Bao
